# Scenario: after a successful compose up and nginx reload, pending markers are gone.
# Healthy cycle must not leave infra/.apply_pending, apps/<name>/.apply_pending,
# or nginx/.reload_pending.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: pending markers cleared baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-pendclr-web
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9972/
stdout 'PENDCLR_OK'
! exists $HOME/infra/.apply_pending
! exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-pendclr/.apply_pending
! exists $HOME/infra/nginx/.reload_pending

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-pendclr-web
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9972/
stdout 'PENDCLR_OK'
! exists $HOME/infra/.apply_pending
! exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-pendclr/.apply_pending
! exists $HOME/infra/nginx/.reload_pending

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-pendclr
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9972
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-pendclr/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=PENDCLR_OK"]
-- .env --
